Matters in which they change for a woman more than for a man • and in it is one section One does not place the bed of a woman in the street because of honor, lest blood exit from her and she be disgraced. And one does not go up in a gathering of the city for a woman (Tur and the Rema). That is to say: that the greatest person in the city—it is not for his honor to escort the woman (see Shach). And some say that regarding escorting there is no difference between a man and a woman, but rather that they do not stand in a group in the street of the city, regarding what the Tur wrote in siman 376 (Tur Yoreh Deah 376) regarding the blessing of the open space, see there. And among us they have abolished it, as will be explained there. And so appears to be the primary view.
